where: first paragraph, 'on notera (9.4.8) que cette extension panachée'
scan: on notera (9.4.8) que cette extension panachée X̄_n se trouve déterminée ainsi à isomorphisme unique près
note: Exposé IX has no 9.4.8: section 9.4 ends with Proposition 9.4.7 (9.4.7.1 to 9.4.7.3, proof ending on folio 432), followed by 9.5. Uniqueness up to unique isomorphism is the full faithfulness of the functor (9.4.7.1) stated in 9.4.7. The exposé's references into 9.4 use shifted numbers elsewhere (folio 432 cites '(9.4.6.2)' for the pairing (9.4.7.2)), so the intended number is not certain. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

The print has Psi (the glyph of (11.8.2), unlike the Phi of the next display). Φ[K'](ℓ) is meant: (11.8.3) is (11.6.2) applied to A[K'], and the proof of 11.9 cites 'la caractérisation (11.8.3) de l'image de Φ[K'](ℓ)'. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
